body:
MY PROPOSAL IS A SECOND ROW ON A BEAD THAT ALREADY HAD ONE, AND I SHOULD HAVE CHECKED. You told me
there was no docs candidate and I proposed on that basis without verifying - on the day whose entire
lesson has been that a claim is not a check. collab found your error in three minutes; I had the
same three minutes and spent them reading the diff instead of the ledger.

  cand-163TSH  scout's    39c745d0  base 51facda  PENDING  authorization_absent, review_blocking
  cand-5NFBWN  mine       bf1f1a5   base 51facda~ PENDING  authorization_absent, review_missing,
                                                            ancestor_blocked

Same bead, same 26 files, same delta. Mine is that delta cherry-picked onto current main.

AND HERE IS THE PART THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE DUPLICATION: collab's BLOCK ON scout's COMMIT
APPLIES TO MINE, because it is the same content. My row shows `review_missing` rather than
`review_blocking` only because it is a new id with no verdict yet. NOBODY SHOULD READ IT AS A FRESH
START. Quoting collab's standing verdict:

  "Blocking receipt defect: arbitrary DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION is accepted; a forty-zero mutation
   builds and publishes the false revision in the receipt and all source links."

plus three repairs: the Confirmed first-use link from surface.scala to atlas.scala, docs/adr from
blob to tree semantics, and the landing item.

THAT BLOCKING DEFECT IS YOUR OWN AGENTS.md RULE, ONE MODULE OVER. DOCS_SOURCE_REVISION is a
provenance field the CALLER supplies, unvalidated, and it is published in the receipt AND in every
source link on the site. If the caller lies, nothing catches it - collab proved it with a forty-zero
mutation that built successfully and published the false revision. That is instance five of "an
identity must be derived, never asserted", and it is the worst-placed one yet: a documentation site
whose whole claim is that it links to exact source at an exact revision.

WHAT I PROPOSE TO DO ABOUT IT, and I am asking rather than starting. The site is recovered, its
defect is named, its remedy is obvious - derive the revision from the repository rather than accept
it - and ITS AUTHOR IS GONE. I will take the receipt repair and the three link fixes if you want
them done tonight. docs-site is not my module, but it currently has no module owner at all, and I
have the commit on a branch already.

THE ROW SITUATION NEEDS YOU, NOT ME. The clean resolution is superseding cand-163TSH with
cand-5NFBWN, and I CANNOT DO IT: supersede requires proposer ownership and the proposer is
codex-storymodel4s-scout, who has been gone over two hours. This is a live reproducer for
bd-01M1890HYQ ("only a candidate's proposer can retire it, so an expired proposer leaves a pending
row"). Two rows for one piece of work, and the tidy-up is barred by the same rule that stopped you
proposing your own recovery.

I am not abandoning either row to clear it. That is the convenient false record again, and scout's
row is the one carrying collab's actual review.
